pages.title: What it does
text: It drives the vanilla minecraft:attack_damage attribute, raising your melee damage. Bare hands, swords, axes, pickaxes and shovels all benefit.
It is the base value: critical multipliers and enchantments (Sharpness and friends) are applied after it, so this dimension is amplified by those multipliers.
1 damage = 1 health point = half a heart.

pages.title: Flat (numeric) line
text: The curve is LINEAR: +0.5 attack damage per point, with no ceiling.

A player's attack damage base is 1.0, and a netherite axe adds +9 more from equipment (equipment and points are additive). So 20 points is 11.0 damage bare-handed and 20.0 damage with a netherite axe.

pages.title: Percent line
text: Also LINEAR: +3% per point, on the TOTAL basis.
TOTAL means the percentage scales base 1.0 + every ADD_VALUE your gear contributes + the result of the flat line. Wearing a strong weapon therefore amplifies the percent line.
Worked example (netherite axe): 20 flat + 20 percent -> (1 + 9 + 10) * (1 + 60%) = 32.0 attack damage.

pages.title: Ceiling & returns
text: There is no designed functional ceiling here: both lines are linear, so every point pays out forever.

The only boundary is the attribute's own range: vanilla clamps attack_damage at 2048 (an attribute-range mod such as AttributeFix raises that automatically). With a +9 netherite axe in hand, reaching it takes roughly 4076 flat points or roughly 6793 percent points. Past that further points do nothing and the row shows a "!" marker.
With diminishing returns removed, attack damage is no longer special - every dimension grows faster now; this one is simply the most visible.

pages.title: Practical advice
text: Early on, prefer the flat line: two points buy one damage (half a heart), which is the most direct upgrade at the iron-sword stage.
Later, the percent line wins: the better your weapon and the more flat points you hold, the larger the absolute amount it multiplies out.
The two lines do not conflict. A common pattern is 20..40 flat points and then everything into percent.
